caption: The drawing features a detailed, shaded illustration of a teapot positioned in the center of the composition, rendered in gray pencil on an off-white background. The teapot has an ornate, curved handle on the right and a long, sweeping spout on the left, with a rounded, bulbous body and a dome-shaped lid topped by a small finial. The main illustration is enclosed within a square border. Below the main teapot, there are three smaller technical drawings: at the bottom left is a side and top view of the handle, at the bottom center is a circular top view of the teapot’s base, and at the bottom right is a simplified outline side view of the entire teapot marked with dimensions. The drawing includes scale notations and measurement lines, and all lines and shading are in varying tones of graphite pencil.
title: Pewter Coffee Pot
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
